$comment: Manifest for the public site. The deploy script publishes ONLY what is listed here — there are no exclusion rules and no size heuristics. Add a file here and it ships; forget it and it does not. Paths are repo-relative and support * and ** globs.
$fonts_comment: Leave empty to ship no fonts (the UI falls back to system fonts by design). Set it to the folder you upload to your own domain, e.g. https://example.com/odina/fonts/ — every 'fonts/vendor/' reference in the shipped HTML is rewritten to it at build time.
$include_comment: Deliberately excluded: fonts/ (23 MB, served from your CDN), docs/ (reading material, belongs on GitHub), tools/ (developer only), locales/ (compiled into the app), *.py and *.sh.
